items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The musicians were trumpet players like Oliver Beana... They would all come to the house... I really think it was... hearing the sound, live jazz, from Oliver Beana... that I decided I wanted to play the trumpet... they were kind of my idols

ctx.x: Do you remember the first live jazz that you heard?

The first live jazz? Well, I guess the first live jazz was, actually, my sisters, they had a tape recorder given to them for Christmas. From that, the boy who were in—they went to junior high school 40 also—the boys from junior high school 40 who played music, would come over to the house and put on records like Miles Davis’ gig. They would play along with these records and record them. The musicians were trumpet players like Oliver Beana, Vincent McEwan, saxophonist George Braithway, his name now is called…
How old were you then? They were about ten years older than you, those musicians.
